name: work
description: The work layer on the kernel: the native assistant's tool surface and situation, teammates, the three-layer memory and the Engineer. Every call goes through the kernel with the chain the kernel builds for the caller; nothing here holds authority.

tools.name: work.tools
tools.summary: the tools this caller may use in this Space, generated from its definitions

tools.name: work.call
tools.summary: run one of those tools; an outward act comes back held for approval

tools.name: work.project.create
tools.summary: make a Project: one record with its Drive folder, repository and memory scope

tools.name: work.project.move-plan
tools.summary: what moving a Project to another Space would carry, and the hash the person approves

tools.name: work.project.move
tools.summary: move a Project to another Space as a new project there, with one yes

tools.name: work.know.move-export
tools.summary: a project's Work-engine lines, read for a move between Spaces (needs the move's own event)

tools.name: work.know.move-import
tools.summary: write a moved project's Work-engine lines in the target Space (needs the move's own event)

tools.name: work.know.move-forget
tools.summary: drop a moved project's Work-engine lines in the source Space, against the receipt

tools.name: work.move.serve
tools.summary: serve a move to another server from this Space (the spaces module only)

tools.name: work.project.ensure
tools.summary: the Project record for a short name, made if missing (the projects module only)

tools.name: work.team.member
tools.summary: put a teammate on a Project's team as a team-member record, or take it off (the teammates module only)

tools.name: work.project.ref
tools.summary: the Project a record id, address or short name names: its id, address, short name and name

tools.name: work.project.rename
tools.summary: rename a Project from Records: its record, Drive folder and project list follow

tools.name: work.chat.list
tools.summary: the chats you may see: title, project, who, when, status, where it lives; open on the ones you are in

tools.name: work.chat.get
tools.summary: one chat you are in: its record, its slots (assistants and models running in it) and its transcript address

tools.name: work.chat.upgrade-plan
tools.summary: what moving your chats to your other Space would carry (counts and blockers)

tools.name: work.chat.upgrade-move
tools.summary: move your chats to your other Space (Personal to My Cloud), ids kept

tools.name: work.chat.history-import
tools.summary: put back the history of a chat that came with the chat upgrade

tools.name: work.chat.create
tools.summary: start a chat: who is in it and which Project

tools.name: work.chat.change
tools.summary: add or remove people and agents in a chat you are in

tools.name: work.chat.rename
tools.summary: rename a chat you are in: its record and every run agree

tools.name: work.chat.move
tools.summary: move a chat you are in to another Project

tools.name: work.situation
tools.summary: where the caller is: the Space, role, record, team, open tasks, what waits and what is sealed

tools.name: work.team.context
tools.summary: what a teammate starts with for a project, minus sealed fields

tools.name: work.team.add
tools.summary: add an assistant teammate from a Kit role, with grants no wider than the adder's

tools.name: work.team.doing
tools.summary: what each teammate is doing right now

tools.name: work.know.search
tools.summary: search records, events and session lines by meaning, only what the caller may read

tools.name: work.know.answer
tools.summary: answer a question from the Space's own records and history, with citations

tools.name: work.know.suggestions
tools.summary: facts memory proposes for a record, with the lines they came from

tools.name: work.know.capture
tools.summary: keep a session's lines so the Space's memory can answer from what was said; first-party modules only

tools.name: work.know.forget
tools.summary: erase a session's lines and the index rows made from them; first-party modules only

tools.name: work.know.accept
tools.summary: accept a proposed fact onto its record

fields.name: moved_to
fields.label: Moved to (Space and project) when it left this Space

fields.name: moved_from
fields.label: Moved from (Space and project) when it came from another

fields.name: former
fields.label: Former participants (people and agents who could not move with it)
